messages:
nina: Quick sync 80 char	) Embeddings plugin refapp launch next Wed. Need owners for: launch post, short benchmark narrative (embeddings cost & rerank quality), a 30m dev deep-dive webinar, and inbound lead routing into the plugin marketplace. Who can take what?
kyle: I can write the launch post + social snippets. Will keep it ~140 words and call out quickstart, embed-cost metric, and example reranker.
pri: Bench narrative here. Plan: 3 bite-sized benches 1) embed throughput & cost-per-1k, 2) rerank recall@10 vs baseline, 3) batch efficiency with quantized embeddings. Keep results as % deltas.
brandon: Webinar: Thu 16:00 PT for 30m (10m intro, 12m live demo + rerank walkthrough, 8m Qs). I can host and demo the plugin flow into a simple search app.
event-bot: Demo infra provisioned: emb-plugin-demo (2xA10G, 1xjumpbox). URL: https://demo.redwood.ai/emb-plugin/v0.1. Read-only token issued. Expires in 96h.
design: Ill make two cards: 1) quickstart hero, 2) bench highlight. Need hero line + color palette by Tue noon.
pri: Draft hero metric for the post: "~2.1x lower embed cost per 1k with quant+batching vs baseline"  Ill validate and attach a tiny 3-row summary (throughput/cost/recall).
kyle: For the post include a tiny reproduce snippet (<=4 lines) so devs can run a sanity check locally.
pri: Snippet draft:
```
# quick embed smoke
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"input\":\"short text\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
# batch bench
python bench/embed_bench.py --batch 64 --iters 200
```
kyle: Nice. For inbound routing, propose campaign MKG-EMB-2026-02, tag "emb-plugin-launch". High intent = demo-clicks>2 OR attended + "want-pilot" checked -> route to AE Plugin queue. Low intent -> 14-day nurture.
brandon: Also want a short workshop signup checkbox on the form so we can measure hands-on interest.
design: Uploaded card drafts to /assets/emb-plugin-card-1.png and -2.png. Please review.
pri: Ill run final benches Tue night and post a small CSV + the 3-row summary to the shared folder. Will present only % improvements and an optional raw CSV.
kyle: Timeline: post -> 1h social push -> targeted community email -> webinar page -> 24h reminder -> webinar. Ill draft email lines: "New: Embeddings plugin + reproducible benches" and reminder "Tomorrow: plugin demo + bench walkthrough".
event-bot: Dry-run cluster ready Mon 06:00 PT. Please do not use production tokens.
nina: Owners: kyle=post+email+social, pri=bench+metrics, brandon=webinar+demo, design=cards, event-bot=infra. Check-in Tue 10:00 PT. Any blockers?
pri: No blockers. Will post numbers by Tue 22:00 PT.
brandon: Ill prepare slides and repo demo steps. Need a moderator for live chat  volunteers?
kyle: I can moderate live chat during the demo.
nina: Awesome, thanks all :rocket: Keep language dev-friendly and keep the bench reproducible.
